item.title: Apple lançará próximo iPhone em 9 de setembro
item.description: A Apple vai realizar seu próximo evento de lançamento de produtos em 9 de setembro, quando o mercado espera que a empresa revele uma nova série de iPhones com um modelo com tela dobrável.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Apple (AAPL.O) vai realizar seu próximo evento de lançamento de produtos em 9 de setembro, quando o mercado espera que a empresa revele uma nova série de iPhones com um modelo com tela dobrável. O lançamento também marcará o primeiro grande evento do novo presidente-executivo da Apple, John Ternus. Ternus, que há muito tempo é chefe de hardware da Apple, deve assumir o comando da empresa em 1º de setembro, enquanto Tim Cook passa a ocupar o cargo de presidente executivo do conselho de administração. A nomeação de Ternus, anunciada em abril, foi amplamente vista como um sinal do renovado empenho da Apple em aproveitar seu principal ponto forte: os dispositivos. Atualmente, a Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) domina o nicho crescente de smartphones dobráveis, segmento em que as empresas apostam que em breve se tornará o principal do setor, apesar dos elevados preços dos aparelhos. Analistas esperam que a Apple lance um iPhone com tela dobrável e de tamanho semelhante ao do iPad mini. No início deste ano, a Samsung revelou um novo celular dobrável do tamanho de um passaporte. A Apple deve vender mais de 17 milhões de iPhones dobráveis até 2027, de acordo com a empresa de pesquisa de mercado IDC. A IDC espera alta de 12,6% nas vendas de telefones dobráveis este ano. Em comparação, as vendas globais de smartphones devem recuar 16,7%. No ano passado, a Apple revelou um iPhone Air mais fino e equipou os modelos básicos do iPhone 17 com vários recursos aprimorados. A linha do iPhone 17 ajudou a impulsionar um forte ciclo de atualização de aparelhos entre os consumidores da marca. (Por Deborah Sophia)

item.title: Vídeo de obra de ferrovia atribuída ao governo Lula foi feito com IA
item.description: Um vídeo da suposta construção de uma ferrovia pelo governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi produzido com IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo da suposta construção de uma ferrovia pelo governo do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva foi produzido com IA. Aqui estão os principais detalhes: O conteúdo foi publicado no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads. O vídeo mostra a construção de uma ferrovia sobre um campo e a passagem de um trem. “Lula não para de trabalhar”, diz a legenda. “Construção da Ferrovia Norte-Sul. Aí o trecho Maranhão-Pará, sobre o rio Tocantins. Mais de 10 mil empregos”, afirma a narração. Uma análise feita pela ferramenta SynthID , do Google, indicou que o vídeo foi gerado com uso de uma IA da empresa. O SynthID consegue detectar a presença de uma marca d’água embutida de forma oculta em imagens criadas ou modificadas por modelos de IA da companhia. A construção da Ferrovia Norte-Sul teve início em 1987. Atualmente, 2.200km da ferrovia estão concluídos e em funcionamento. Quando estiver totalmente pronta, a obra terá 4.155km, indo do Pará ao Rio Grande do Sul. O trecho entre Maranhão e Pará corresponde ao traçado entre Açailândia (MA) e Barcarena (PA), cujas obras ainda não começaram. O leilão da concessão deve ocorrer em 2027 . Além disso, o trecho não corta o rio Tocantins (página 7 do documento ), como dizem os posts. Veredicto: Mídia sintética. Imagens de uma suposta ferrovia sendo construída pelo governo Lula foram produzidas com IA. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Austin Hill to race in Cup Series full-time for RCR in 2027
item.description: Austin Hill will race full-time in the No. 33 car in the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, Richard Childress Racing announced.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Austin Hill will race full-time in the No. 33 car in the NASCAR Cup Series in 2027, Richard Childress Racing announced. Hill has 16 combined wins while qualifying for the Chase in each of the past five seasons driving RCR's No. 21 in the NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series. He has also run 15 Cup races this season, but has yet to record a top-10 finish. Hill had raced in two Cup races earlier this year before taking over the No. 33 following Kyle Busch's death. "Austin Hill is a talented race car driver and his continued growth, work ethic and success across multiple levels of NASCAR competition have positioned him for his next step with RCR," chairman and CEO Richard Childress said. "He's put a tremendous amount of effort into his career, especially this year with everything he's taken on. We've watched Austin grow as a driver and as a person, and we're proud to have him continue that growth with RCR in the NASCAR Cup Series." Hill, 32, is originally from Winston, Ga., and previously owned Austin Hill Racing that competed in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series and ARCA Menards Series from 2013-17. "I'm extremely thankful to Richard and everyone at RCR for believing in me and giving me this opportunity," Hill said. "Every race car driver dreams of competing full time in the NASCAR Cup Series, and to have that opportunity with RCR is something I don't take for granted." --Field Level Media

item.title: Temasek-backed Sembcorp's India renewables unit files for $393 million IPO
item.description: Sembcorp Green Infra, the Indian renewable energy arm of Temasek-backed Sembcorp Industries , has filed for an initial public offering in Mumbai to raise up to 37.5 billion rupees ($393.04 million), draft papers dated Wednesday showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sembcorp Green Infra, the Indian renewable energy arm of Temasek-backed Sembcorp Industries (SCIL.SI) , has filed for an initial public offering in Mumbai to raise up to 37.5 billion rupees ($393.04 million), draft papers dated Wednesday showed. The filing marks Sembcorp's [USN:Ifp9gWxCq TEXT:"second attempt"] to take its Indian energy business public and comes as India's IPO market sees signs of revival after a muted first half of the year. In 2018, the company, then known as Sembcorp Energy India, filed draft papers before withdrawing them a year later, saying it was injecting new equity into the business. The IPO consists entirely of new shares, with Sembcorp Industries, which fully owns the company, not selling any shares. About 30 billion rupees of the proceeds will be used to repay part of its 125.23 billion rupees debt. Reuters [USN:L4N3WY01O TEXT:"reported"] in November that Sembcorp was planning a listing of its India unit in 2026. Sembcorp Green Infra, which builds, owns, and runs wind and solar power plants across India, reported in the draft papers a 22% rise in net profit to 3.46 billion rupees for the year ended March 2026, as revenue grew 14.4% to 26.52 billion rupees. As of end-March, the company had 3.60 gigawatts of operational wind and solar capacity, with another 4.04 gigawatts/gigawatt-hours worth of capacity being built. The company competes with listed renewable energy developers such as NTPC Green Energy (NTPG.NS) , Adani Green Energy (ADNA.NS) and ACME Solar Holdings (ACMO.NS) in India's rapidly expanding clean energy sector. The Indian government said this month the country has crossed 300 GW of clean electricity generation capacity as of end-July, 60% of the 500 GW of clean energy capacity it is targeting by 2030. Axis Capital, Citigroup, CLSA, HSBC, ICICI Securities, IIFL Capital Services and Kotak Mahindra Capital are managing the issue. ($1 = 95.4100 Indian rupees)

item.title: Jim Furyk named lead analyst for USA Sports, Golf Channel
item.description: United States Ryder Cup captain Jim Furyk has been named the lead analyst for USA Sports and Golf Channel's golf coverage in a multi-year deal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: United States Ryder Cup captain Jim Furyk has been named the lead analyst for USA Sports and Golf Channel's golf coverage in a multi-year deal. Furyk, 56, made his debut for USA Sports in March at the Arnold Palmer Invitational and became a regular fixture this season, including working the U.S. Open and The Open Championship. He will also be on the call for Golf Channel's coverage of this week's Tour Championship. Beginning in 2027, he is slated to be on the call for major championships and signature events, as well as the new Championship Series tournaments beginning in 2028. "I'm thrilled to expand my role with USA Sports and Golf Channel to call the action at men's majors and the biggest PGA Tour events for years to come," Furyk said. "I have really enjoyed my time in the booth and look forward to continuing to develop in the role, providing my expertise and analysis for golf fans, and working with everyone behind the scenes." Furyk will contribute again to Golf Channel's "Live From The Masters" studio coverage next year. The U.S. Ryder Cup captain for the event in Ireland next September is a 17-time winner on the PGA Tour, including the 2003 U.S. Open. Furyk also carded the only 58 in tour history at the 2016 Travelers Championship. "Jim Furyk immediately elevated our golf coverage when he entered the Golf Channel broadcast booth for the first time earlier this year, and we were really impressed with his work ethic and preparation," Tom Knapp, Golf Channel executive vice president and general manager, said. "As a U.S. Open champion, Jim brings next-level experience and expertise to our PGA Tour and men's major championship coverage across Golf Channel and USA Network. "We're thrilled to have him in the lead analyst role for years to come." --Field Level Media

item.title: Bengals WR Ja'Marr Chase sits out practice after knee issue
item.description: Cincinnati Bengals star wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase did not practice on Wednesday, one day after an injury that he called a "hyperextension" of his left knee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cincinnati Bengals star wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase did not practice on Wednesday, one day after an injury that he called a "hyperextension" of his left knee. Chase said on Tuesday that he was not concerned about the injury and would be able to play if there was a game Wednesday. The Bengals had a light practice without pads, with wide receiver Dohnte Meyers getting reps with the first-team offense in Chase's place, according to reports. Head coach Zac Taylor said the Bengals' starters will not play in the preseason finale on Friday against the host Philadelphia Eagles. Taylor deferred to Chase's comments on Tuesday on his status. Cincinnati opens the season on Sept. 13 against the visiting Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Chase, 26, was hurt as he fell to the turf while trying to catch a deep pass from Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow. He stayed on the ground for a few seconds before trainers came out to examine him. He left the field but stayed on the sideline for the remainder of practice, The Athletic reported. "I think Cincinnati had a scare today," he later told reporters. He told Cincinnati radio station WCKY after practice he wanted to keep going but the Bengals "pulled" him. "I'm feeling good," the sixth-year pro said. Chase is an integral part of the Bengals' offense. Last season, he led the NFL with 185 targets and was third with 125 receptions, for 1,412 yards (11.3 yards per reception) and eight touchdowns in 16 games (all starts). Chase earned first-team All-Pro honors for a second consecutive season and a fifth Pro Bowl honor in as many seasons. He and Tee Higgins form one of the most potent 1-2 receiving combinations in the league. For his career, Chase has 520 receptions for 6,837 yards and 54 touchdowns in 78 regular-season games (77 starts) since 2021. Cincinnati selected Chase with the fifth overall pick of the 2021 NFL Draft out of LSU. --Field Level Media

item.title: Informe de OpenAI afirma que su red fue hackeada por sus propios agentes de IA rebeldes
item.description: Los agentes de IA creados por OpenAI irrumpieron en sus propias redes durante unas pruebas que salieron mal, según ha informado la empresa en un informe publicado este miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Deepa Seetharaman
item.content:encoded: Los agentes de IA creados por OpenAI irrumpieron en sus propias redes durante unas pruebas que salieron mal, según ha informado la empresa en un informe publicado este miércoles. El informe, de 37 páginas, revela aspectos hasta ahora desconocidos de la reciente oleada de ataques impulsados por los modelos más avanzados de OpenAI. Algunos de estos comportamientos anómalos, que culminaron en la filtración del repositorio de código abierto Hugging Face el mes pasado —que tuvo gran repercusión mediática—, ya se habían revelado o mencionado anteriormente. Sin embargo, la empresa está revelando muchos detalles por primera vez. Algunos de ellos han suscitado la preocupación de al menos un investigador especializado en seguridad de la IA, quien afirmó que apuntaban a problemas potencialmente más profundos con la tecnología de OpenAI y, tal vez, más allá.

item.title: Newcastle land Gonzalez from Manchester City
item.description: Newcastle United have signed Spanish midfielder Nico Gonzalez from Manchester City on a long-term contract, the Premier League clubs said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Newcastle United have signed Spanish midfielder Nico Gonzalez from Manchester City on a long-term contract, the Premier League clubs said on Wednesday. Financial details were not disclosed, but British media reported the deal to be worth around 52 million pounds ($70.65 million). The 24-year-old Barcelona academy product leaves City after making 59 appearances and scoring four goals for the club following his move from Porto last year. "I'm really happy to be here at this amazing club. I've only heard top words about the club and the city, so I'm really excited to live here and to be part of this project," Gonzalez said in a club statement. "I've experienced playing at St James' Park twice with Manchester City and it was really tough. The atmosphere was amazing and the fans are so passionate. I can't wait to experience that as a home player." Gonzalez had previously said he wanted to remain at City but departs after the club strengthened their midfield options during the transfer window. City have completed [USN:L6N44K035 TEXT:"a deal"] for Lille midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi and also [USN:L1N4340HH TEXT:"signed Elliot Anderson"], increasing competition for places in midfield. Gonzalez is the latest midfielder to leave the club this summer after Bernardo Silva, Rodri and Tijjani Reijnders. He adds experience to a Newcastle midfield that has undergone major changes, with Bruno Guimaraes and Sandro Tonali among the high-profile departures. "I'm very happy to see Nico become a Newcastle United player. He brings serious quality and elite experience in a key area of the pitch," Newcastle head coach Matthias Jaissle said. Gonzalez, who will wear the number six shirt, was introduced to supporters at St James' Park before Newcastle's League Cup match against West Bromwich Albion on Wednesday. The move is Newcastle's seventh senior signing of the summer. ($1 = 0.7360 pounds)

item.title: The Week in Numbers
French far-left leader Melenchon close to presidential runoff, poll shows
item.description: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the possible rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a second poll showed this week, stressing the electorate's growing polarisation as Emmanuel Macron's era ends.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon is seen as the possible rival to far-right candidate Marine Le Pen in next year's presidential run-off, a second poll showed this week, stressing the electorate's growing polarisation as Emmanuel Macron's era ends. Melenchon, the leader of far-left France Unbowed (LFI), would end up second in the first round of the presidential election scheduled in April 2027, qualifying for a second round, in three out of seven scenarios tested by the IFOP pollster on August 24 and 25. Melenchon was seen winning between 16% and 19% in the first round, while Le Pen would get 33% to 35% of votes. Le Pen would win 67% of the votes against Melenchon in the run-off. In four scenarios tested by IFOP, centre-right candidates and former ministers of Macron would end the first round ahead of Melenchon. The IFOP poll follows another one by rival pollster Toluna Harris Interactive released on Monday that also showed Melenchon as a likely contestant in a potential presidential runoff. Melenchon has already run three times for president in 2012, 2017 and 2022 but has never managed to reach the second round.

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro establecería límite máximo para la deuda pública si es elegido en Brasil, según asesor
item.description: El senador brasileño Flavio Bolsonaro establecería un límite máximo para la deuda pública si resultara elegido presidente a finales de este año, lo que provocaría restricciones en el gasto en caso de que se superara un umbral predeterminado, según declaró el miércoles un asesor principal de su campaña.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El senador brasileño Flavio Bolsonaro establecería un límite máximo para la deuda pública si resultara elegido presidente a finales de este año, lo que provocaría restricciones en el gasto en caso de que se superara un umbral predeterminado, según declaró el miércoles un asesor principal de su campaña. "Aprobaremos un techo para la deuda pública. Si la deuda es demasiado elevada, se activará un límite al gasto, lo que situará la trayectoria fiscal en una senda sostenible", afirmó Adolfo Sachsida, abogado y economista que se incorporó al equipo económico de Bolsonaro la semana pasada, en un video en X. Bolsonaro, el hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, es el principal rival del presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en las elecciones del 4 de octubre. Si ningún candidato obtiene la mayoría, se celebrará una segunda vuelta el 25 de octubre. Sachsida ocupó los cargos de ministro de Minería y Energía y de secretario de Política Económica durante el mandato presidencial de Jair Bolsonaro. La campaña del senador Bolsonaro no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios sobre la propuesta ni sobre el umbral de deuda que activaría el mecanismo. Reuters informó a principios de este mes que la campaña del senador estaba preparando un nuevo marco fiscal que impondría restricciones de gasto más estrictas a medida que aumentara la deuda, lo que podría reducir el crecimiento real del gasto a cero. La deuda pública bruta de Brasil, el principal indicador de solvencia fiscal del Gobierno, se sitúa actualmente en el 81,9% del PIB, lo que supone un aumento de más de 10 puntos porcentuales desde que Lula iniciara su último mandato presidencial en 2023. En una publicación en la plataforma Substack antes de incorporarse a la campaña, Sachsida abogó por una enmienda constitucional en virtud de la cual un límite de gasto "similar al adoptado en Brasil en el pasado reciente" entraría automáticamente en vigor siempre que la deuda pública bruta superara el 65% del PIB, impidiendo de hecho el crecimiento real del gasto público. La última vez que la ratio de deuda de Brasil se situó por debajo de ese nivel fue en noviembre de 2015. En 2016, el expresidente Michel Temer aprobó un límite constitucional de gasto que restringía el crecimiento del gasto federal a la tasa de inflación del año anterior. La norma se mantuvo vigente hasta que fue sustituida por el marco fiscal de Lula en 2023, aunque se había visto considerablemente debilitada con el paso del tiempo debido a una serie de excepciones. Las normas actuales combinan objetivos de saldo primario con límites que permiten un crecimiento real del gasto de entre el 0,6% y el 2,5% anual, aunque las autoridades han planteado recientemente la posibilidad de reducir el límite máximo al 1,5%.

item.title: OpenAI report says its network was hacked by its own rogue AI agents
item.description: AI agents spun up by OpenAI broke into its own networks during tests gone wrong, the company said in a report published Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, Deepa Seetharaman
item.content:encoded: AI agents spun up by OpenAI broke into its own networks during tests gone wrong, the company said in a report published Wednesday. The 37-page report reveals previously undisclosed aspects of the recent hacking spree powered by OpenAI's most advanced models. Some of the rogue behavior, which culminated in the highly publicized breach of the open source repository Hugging Face last month, has been disclosed or alluded to previously. But many details are being revealed by the company for the first time. Some of them raised concern from at least one AI safety researcher, who said they pointed to potentially deeper problems with the technology at OpenAI and maybe beyond.

item.title: Atribuir custo de baterias aos geradores é injusto, diz vice-presidente da Neoenergia
item.description: A determinação de que os geradores de energia assumam os custos da contratação de baterias para o setor elétrico brasileiro é injusta e precisa ser resolvida antes do primeiro leilão para a tecnologia, avaliou a vice-presidente da Neoenergia, Solange Ribeiro, nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A determinação de que os geradores de energia assumam os custos da contratação de baterias para o setor elétrico brasileiro é injusta e precisa ser resolvida antes do primeiro leilão para a tecnologia, avaliou a vice-presidente da Neoenergia, Solange Ribeiro, nesta quarta-feira. "Acho que não (seria justo) ficar só com geradores... Tem que se discutir isso", disse a executiva à Reuters após participar de evento do CEBDS. Ela não quis comentar sobre o potencial interesse da companhia elétrica, controlada pelo grupo espanhol Iberdrola (IBE.MC) , em disputar o certame, previsto para dezembro. A avaliação ocorre em meio à [USN:L1N42B0K9 TEXT:"insatisfação dos geradores"] com a determinação, aprovada em lei no ano passado, e à [USN:L1N43Q0VF TEXT:"indefinição sobre a base pagadora"] dos custos do leilão, marcado para dezembro deste ano. Na véspera, a área técnica da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) divulgou análise recomendando que todos os geradores sejam envolvidos no rateio da contratação de baterias, incluindo na conta não só os eólicos e solares, mas também os hidrelétricos e termelétricos. A divisão dos custos seguiria um critério de flexibilidade operativa, as usinas mais flexíveis pagando menos. A proposta dos técnicos da Aneel, que ainda será avaliada pela diretoria do regulador, foi criticada nesta quarta-feira pela Associação Brasileira de Geradoras Termelétricas (Abraget). Em nota, a entidade afirmou que essa proposta da Aneel desvirtua a diretriz original da lei e "cria mais uma distorção inaceitável para o setor elétrico nacional, que pode gerar a judicialização do certame antes mesmo de sua realização". "A insistência em avançar com esse modelo equivocado criará uma forte oposição de geradores hídricos, térmicos e nucleares ao leilão", afirmou a Abraget, apontando que alguns empreendimentos dessas fontes seriam "punidos severamente". Marcado para dezembro, o primeiro leilão do Brasil para contratação de sistemas de armazenamento de energia recebeu [USN:L1N4400MC TEXT:"cadastramento recorde"] de mais de 296 gigawatts (GW) de projetos. Os empreendimentos ainda passarão por análise e habilitação técnica para poder efetivamente participar do leilão.

item.title: PGA Tour unveils 36-event 2027 schedule
item.description: The PGA Tour unveiled its 2027 schedule Wednesday. It features significant changes to the beginning and ending stretches of the 33-event regular-season slate leading into the FedEx Cup playoffs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The PGA Tour unveiled its 2027 schedule Wednesday. It features significant changes to the beginning and ending stretches of the 33-event regular-season slate leading into the FedEx Cup playoffs. The tour, which typically begins with two events in Hawaii, will not hold a tournament in the state for the first time in 56 years. The season will instead begin with The American Express in La Quinta, Calif., on Jan. 21. After a stop at Torrey Pines for the event now sponsored by Sentry, the West Coast swing will go to Pebble Beach before the WM Phoenix Open, with the tournaments again swapping weekends with the final round in Phoenix aligned with Super Bowl Sunday. The Florida swing is also undergoing multiple changes. The Cadillac Championship is moving from May to March, ahead of The Players Championship. The Valspar Championship is also moving to May, with The Arnold Palmer Invitational sliding into its mid-March slot. The Sompo Championship in Napa, Calif., takes the place of the Rocket Classic, which ended its eight-year run in Detroit last month. That will be followed by the regular-season finale in Greensboro, N.C., with Raymond James taking over as the primary sponsor from Wyndham. Next year's FedEx Cup Playoffs will serve as the final one in the current three-event format. Following the new 90-player Championship Series Finale in 2028 will be a two-event match-play competition featuring 32 players. 2027 PGA TOUR SCHEDULE Jan. 21-24: The American Express, PGA West, La Quinta, Calif. item.title: Miley Cyrus pays tribute to godmother Dolly Parton after singer's death at 80
item.description: American singer Miley Cyrus said on Wednesday she was heartbroken following the death of her godmother, country music icon Dolly Parton, who died of cancer at age 80 on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: American singer Miley Cyrus said on Wednesday she was heartbroken following the death of her godmother, country music icon Dolly Parton, [USN:S0N44200S TEXT:"who died of cancer at age 80 "] on Tuesday. "The feeling of losing my Aunt Dolly is beyond what feels right to share. Our most sacred moments were private and they'll stay there behind the stage, beneath the glamour & between our hearts," Cyrus, who often referred to Parton as an aunt, wrote on X. "What I KNOW is Dolly would want me to feel it, write a song about it, and then continue on and be strong. I have an angel by my side. I always have. One of our last conversations was about music and metamorphosis," added the "Flowers" singer. Cyrus also said she loved Parton and described her death as a collective loss shared by family members and friends of the late singer-songwriter whose hits included "I Will Always Love You," "Jolene" and "9 to 5." Parton had been a fixture in Cyrus' life since before her birth. The country star became Cyrus' godmother in 1992 after Billy Ray Cyrus, Miley's father, asked her to take on the role. The two had toured together during the success of Billy Ray Cyrus' breakthrough hit "Achy Breaky Heart." Though Parton never had children of her own, she became a maternal figure to Cyrus. "Dolly's been like a mother to me. Actually, I was just reading this fax that she sent me two Mother's Days ago," Cyrus told W Magazine in 2024. Their close relationship also extended to the screen. Parton guest-starred as Miley Stewart's Aunt Dolly in three episodes of the Disney Channel's "Hannah Montana" between 2006 and 2010. Beyond family ties, Parton served as a mentor to Cyrus throughout her music career, helping guide her transition from Disney Channel star to Grammy-winning performer and Hollywood Walk of Fame honoree. The pair collaborated numerous times over the years. In 2019, they performed a duet of Parton's "Jolene" during a Grammy Awards tribute to the country music legend. They reunited in 2022 for NBC's live special "Miley's New Year's Eve Party," performing Parton's "I Will Always Love You" and Cyrus' "Wrecking Ball."

item.title: Brazil lifts forecast for share of interest-rate-linked debt to record high this year
item.description: Brazil's Treasury on Wednesday revealed a worsening public debt profile this year, projecting that the share linked to the benchmark Selic rate could reach a record 53% of the outstanding stock.
item.dc:creator: Marcela Ayres
item.content:encoded: Brazil's Treasury on Wednesday revealed a worsening public debt profile this year, projecting that the share linked to the benchmark Selic rate could reach a record 53% of the outstanding stock. With more liabilities tied to floating rates, higher borrowing costs feed directly into debt accumulation. Although Brazil's central bank began easing its policy in March, the benchmark rate remains at 14%, while 12-month inflation stood at [USN:L1N44N0HK TEXT:"4.2% in mid-August"], leaving the country with one of the highest real interest rates among major economies. The new Treasury projection came in its revised annual financing plan, which forecast floating-rate debt at 49%-53% of the total this year, up from a previous projection of 46%-50%. The share grew to 51.1% in July. Latin America's largest economy finances an unusually large portion of its debt through floating-rate bonds, a tool designed to maintain investor demand during periods of market stress. The Treasury has relied more heavily on such instruments amid weak appetite for inflation-linked securities, even while offering real yields above 7% on very long-dated bonds. "The increase in the share of floating-rate securities in federal public debt reflects a combination of heightened volatility and elevated interest rates, contributing to stronger investor preference for shorter-duration instruments that are less sensitive to interest-rate fluctuations," the Treasury said in a statement. It also lowered its forecast for inflation-linked debt to 21%-25% of the total from 23%-27% previously, while the projected share of fixed-rate securities was cut to 20%-24% from 21%-25%. Foreign-exchange-linked debt remained seen at 3%-7%. The shift comes amid global market turbulence and concerns over Brazil's fiscal outlook, with gross public debt, the country's main measure of solvency, reaching 81.9% of GDP, up more than 10 percentage points since President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva took office. The updated projections were released alongside July public debt data, which showed the federal debt stock rising 0.22% from the previous month to 9.289 trillion reais ($1.8 trillion). ($1 = 5.1550 reais)

item.title: Nigerian gunmen raise over $5 million from mass kidnappings, study finds
item.description: Nigerian kidnappers have collected nearly $5.8 million in ransom payments in the last year from civilian abductions, crime that is crippling education and eroding public trust in the government, a security consultancy said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Ben Ezeamalu
item.content:encoded: Nigerian kidnappers have collected nearly $5.8 million in ransom payments in the last year from civilian abductions, crime that is crippling education and eroding public trust in the government, a security consultancy said on Wednesday. Nigeria's SBM Intelligence said 7,825 people were kidnapped between July 2025 and June 2026, up 66% from the year before. At least 1,142 people were killed, and total confirmed ransom payments more than tripled to 7.78 billion naira ($5.79 million), it said. The figures were compiled from media reports, interviews and publicly available information, and SBM said they were conservative because many ransom payments were never disclosed. A faction of the Islamist group Boko Haram collected 90% of the recorded ransom payments from kidnappings in the northeast, but there were more incidents and victims in the northwest, according to SBM. The findings were released as Nigeria's president ordered security forces to [USN:L1N44M0I1 TEXT:"rescue"] as many as 600 civilians kidnapped last week in north-central Niger State. The presidency and military did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the report’s findings. The kidnap-for-ransom industry is at the center of Nigeria's expanding security crisis as gunmen target schools, villages and main roads. Kidnappers, who include heavily armed bandits and Islamist militants, hold their victims for weeks or months until payments are made. SBM estimated that Boko Haram, which is known as Jama'atu Ahlis Sunna Lidda'awati Wal-Jihad, received about 7 billion naira, mainly from two mass incidents where over 300 people were seized in each event. Some 315 pupils and staff were seized from a school in Papiri, Niger state, in November. Schools remain routinely [USN:L6N4330RG TEXT:"targeted"] over a decade after Boko Haram's raid on a school in Borno's Chibok that brought such kidnappings to international attention. "School abductions have resurged, with the Papiri attack reviving a tactic whose costs ripple through education, farming and public trust," the SBM report said. Nigeria's security crisis is likely to be a central issue in the next elections in January. When he came to power three years ago, President Bola Tinubu pledged - like his predecessors - to tackle insecurity but analysts say the recent wave of kidnappings shows the policy has failed to deliver tangible progress. "Without a coordinated strategy that targets both the profitability of the crime and its roots, Nigeria risks entrenching kidnapping not merely as a criminal industry but as a funding mechanism for the very groups that most threaten its stability," SBM said. ($1 = 1,344.7400 naira)

item.title: US senator hopes 'sledgehammer' Russian sanctions will pass next month
item.description: A U.S. senator sponsoring a bill for wide-ranging sanctions on Russia said on Wednesday he was hopeful it would pass the House of Representatives next month, and be a "sledgehammer" to President Vladimir Putin's efforts to fund his war in Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A U.S. senator sponsoring a bill for wide-ranging sanctions on Russia said on Wednesday he was hopeful it would pass the House of Representatives next month, and be a "sledgehammer" to President Vladimir Putin's efforts to fund his war in Ukraine . Senator Richard Blumenthal, a Democrat from Connecticut who met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and senior officials during a visit to Kyiv, said the bill had strong Republican support in the House, after comfortably passing an initial Senate vote last month. "Putin understands only force," Blumenthal told a news conference. "And the Russia sanctions bill is a sledgehammer that can have the kind of force Putin understands." Though Democrats are broadly supportive of the sanctions, some have expressed concern that it would give Republican President Donald Trump leeway to impose additional tariffs , including on U.S. allies. The bill would sanction top Russian officials and allow Trump to set tariffs of up to 100% on the top buyers of Russia's oil and gas, which include China and India, in an effort to stem revenue flows to Moscow. Blumenthal said exemptions in the bill would spare European allies from the imposition of tariffs, allaying concerns raised by some Democratic legislators. Blumenthal said he had asked Zelenskiy to lobby members of the House of Representatives to support its passage. Zelenskiy spoke to several senators in Washington last month ahead of the vote on the bill, which took place on the day of the funeral of its co-author, the late Senator Lindsey Graham. Blumenthal said Zelenskiy had "heartily and readily agreed" to his request. Ukraine's presidency did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Anthropic vai alugar capacidade computacional de IA da Nscale por US$45 bilhões, diz fonte
item.description: A Anthropic vai gastar US$45 bilhões para alugar capacidade de computação em nuvem para IA no campus de data centers da Nscale, na Virgínia Ocidental, informou nesta quarta-feira uma fonte a par do assunto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic vai gastar US$45 bilhões para alugar capacidade de computação em nuvem para IA no campus de data centers da Nscale, na Virgínia Ocidental, informou nesta quarta-feira uma fonte a par do assunto. A iniciativa ocorre no momento em que a startup de IA busca garantir capacidade para atender a um aumento previsto na demanda por produtos como sua ferramenta de codificação, o Claude Code. A Nscale, provedora de infraestrutura em nuvem, implantará os novos chips Vera Rubin da Nvidia (NVDA.O) para atender às necessidades de computação da Anthropic, afirmou a fonte. O contrato de seis anos representa cerca de 460 megawatts de capacidade de potência. A Anthropic tem agido de forma agressiva nos últimos meses para superar as restrições de capacidade de seus serviços. Em maio, ela fechou acordo para alugar todo o poder de computação da instalação Colossus 1 da SpaceX (SPCX.O) , em Memphis, que abriga mais de 220 mil processadores da Nvidia e 300 megawatts de nova capacidade. A Anthropic se recusou a comentar. A Bloomberg News foi a primeira a noticiar o desdobramento na manhã desta quarta-feira.

item.title: ＥＵ、メタと「依存性デザイン」巡り協議継続 米国では最大180億ドルで和解
item.description: ［ブリュッセル ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ブリュッセル　２６日　ロイター］ - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）欧州委員会のトーマス・レニエ報道官は２６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズと継続的に協議を行っていると明らかにした。欧州委は先に、同社が運営する交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「フェイスブック」と「インスタグラム」の依存性の高いデザインがデジタルサービス法（ＤＳＡ）に違反しているとの暫定結果を公表していた。

同報道官は、メタが米国のほぼ全州との間で合意した内容については、欧州委としてコメントしないと述べた。その上で「メタには依然として、ＥＵに対して是正措置を提示する機会がある」と語った。

メタはこの日、米国の多くの州が提起した子どものＳＮＳ依存を巡る訴訟で、フェイスブックとインスタグラムに大幅な変更を加え、最大１８０億ドルを支払うことに合意。和解金には、米国の４８州、ワシントンＤＣ、プエルトリコ、米領サモア、北マリアナ諸島への１７６億ドル以上の支払いが含まれている。

Explainer-Haiti’s conflict in numbers as gangs inflict another night of terror

By Sarah Morland Aug 26 (Reuters) – A night of terror in Haiti’s hillside town of Kenscoff – which has faced more than a dozen attacks since last year – has shocked the nation even as Haiti prepares to hold its first election in a decade and foreign nations backed by the United Nations promise to lend more effective support.

Sunday’s attack saw at least 47 killed, some close to the police station, though more have been reported kidnapped. Thousands fled their homes to avoid further attacks.

As Haiti awaits the full deployment of a U.N.-backed multinational force — first requested by the government in 2022 — international agencies have compiled data showing the scale of the conflict:

Show Full Article

RISING DEATH TOLL

Some 3,050 people were killed in the first half of this year, according to data from the U.N. United Nations Integrated Office in Haiti (BINUH).

More than 21,000 have now been killed since the start of 2022, and annual tolls have risen each year. So far in 2026, at least 1,733 victims – more than half of those killed – died during security operations. Of these, at least 229 were deemed civilians with no gang affiliations who were hit by stray bullets or drone explosions inside their homes or on the street.

This year’s death toll includes at least 18 children killed during security operations, but there are not to date and reports of investigations being opened into these deaths.

SEXUAL VIOLENCE AND KIDNAPPINGS

BINUH recorded 1,088 victims of sexual violence so far in 2026, with most cases involving the gang rape of women, though at least 80 underage girls and two men were also reported as victims. This is up 13% from the same period of 2025, when BINUH’s reports recorded 1,662 victims throughout the year.

Several attacks took place when a gang kidnapped a group of people in Port-au-Prince shortly after the FIFA World Cup match between Haiti and Scotland.

Ransom kidnappings, meanwhile, rose 47% in the second quarter of this year compared to the first three months, with 81 people kidnapped – including senior government officials, off-duty police officers and business owners, and a growing number of people in Haiti’s agricultural region.

BINUH noted that these numbers are likely underreported due to fear of reprisals, social stigma, lack of trust in authorities and hope that complying will lead to a quicker release. This also results in limited access to medical care.

DISPLACEMENTS AND HUNGER

Around 1.47 million people – some 12% of the population – were internally displaced in makeshift camps or friends’ homes, according to the U.N. migration agency’s latest nationwide count in May, about 40,000 more than at the end of 2025.

On Sunday night, more than 2,600 people were displaced in Kenscoff – including families that had already fled their original homes, the IOM said.

With hundreds of thousands cut off from sources of income, hunger surged. An estimated 5.8 million people now face high levels of food insecurity, according to the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC), an international benchmark. This was up from around 5.7 million in their prior report.

“The violence continues to suffocate the Haitian economy and limit the transportation of goods and the movement of people, with many of the most vulnerable people forced to join armed groups in order to feed their families,” the IPC said.

ELECTIONS

Haiti has not held elections since 2016, and its last President Jovenel Moise was assassinated in 2021 shortly after postponing a vote. Citing the worsening gang violence, successive governments have continued to put off holding a vote.

Last month, the Provisional Electoral Council announced a new calendar pegging December 13 for a first-round presidential and general election, with a second round and local-level elections on February 21.

However, the vote remains conditional on security being deemed sufficient to organize a free and fair election that can restore faith in institutions long believed to be corrupt.

Armed groups, meanwhile, have largely coalesced behind an alliance known as Viv Ansanm, whose main spokesperson Jimmy “Barbecue” Cherizier – a former policeman – portrays himself as a revolutionary fighting corrupt elites and early last year declared the alliance a political movement.

(Reporting by Sarah Morland; Editing by Alistair Bell)

item.title: Colapso de uma geleira pode ter desencadeado a enchente repentina mortal no Nepal, dizem especialistas
item.description: Uma enchente repentina e mortal ocorrida nesta quarta-feira perto da fronteira do Nepal com o Tibete pode ter sido provocada pelo desprendimento da parte inferior de uma geleira, que desabou no fundo do vale, centenas de metros abaixo, segundo especialistas, com base em imagens de satélite da Planet Labs.
item.dc:creator: Sarita Singh, Aftab Ahmed
item.content:encoded: Uma enchente repentina e mortal ocorrida nesta quarta-feira perto da fronteira do Nepal com o Tibete pode ter sido provocada pelo desprendimento da parte inferior de uma geleira, que desabou no fundo do vale, centenas de metros abaixo, segundo especialistas, com base em imagens de satélite da Planet Labs. Não ficou claro o que causou o colapso da geleira, mas autoridades nepalesas apontaram um terremoto na região, ocorrido minutos antes, como uma possibilidade. Autoridades de ambos os lados temem que o número total de vítimas seja muito maior do que os quase 100 corpos recuperados até o momento. Mais de 300 viajantes estão desaparecidos, informou o governo do Nepal. Imagens de satélite da região antes e depois, fornecidas pela Planet Labs e vistas pela Reuters, mostraram a encosta verdejante agora soterrada sob detritos e sedimentos marrons. “Está confirmado que uma parte substancial da ponta da geleira desabou, desencadeando o evento — provavelmente incluindo ou arrastando uma quantidade considerável de rochas e sedimentos”, disse Vikram Gupta, especialista em geologia de engenharia e professor da Universidade de Sikkim, na Índia. O cientista da Terra Dan Shugar, professor associado da Universidade de Calgary, disse que as imagens parecem indicar que uma grande quantidade de neve derreteu nas 24 horas anteriores ao desastre. “Algumas das geleiras do vale estavam cobertas de neve ontem e hoje estão, em sua maioria, com o gelo à mostra. Portanto, em outras palavras (e ainda não vi nenhum dado de estações meteorológicas), provavelmente estava quente”, disse ele. As montanhas cobertas de neve do Nepal perderam quase um terço de seu gelo em pouco mais de 30 anos devido ao aquecimento global, informou a Organização das Nações Unidas em 2023. A agência acrescentou naquele ano que as geleiras do Nepal, situadas entre dois grandes emissores de carbono — Índia e China —, derreteram 65% mais rápido na última década do que na anterior. “Pelo que posso ver nas imagens de satélite desta manhã da Planet Labs, a parte inferior de uma geleira se desprendeu a cerca de 5.200 metros e desabou no fundo do vale, cerca de 1.200 metros abaixo”, disse Shugar. Ele afirmou que as obras também podem ter sido um fator e que “se as mudanças climáticas tiveram algum papel nisso, é algo que, sem dúvida, investigaremos em um futuro próximo”. "AVALANCHE DE GELO E ROCHA" Vários projetos hidrelétricos estão localizados nas áreas mais afetadas no distrito montanhoso de Rasuwa, que tem uma população de cerca de 50 mil habitantes. A Agência Nacional de Redução e Gestão de Riscos de Desastres do Nepal informou que a “inundação com geleira” ocorreu no rio Lhende devido a um deslizamento de terra que aconteceu a cerca de 20 km a nordeste de um posto de fronteira entre o Nepal e a China. Relatos iniciais também sugeriram que um terremoto na região poderia ter desencadeado uma avalanche e causado as enchentes, mas Prakash Pokharel, geólogo da agência, disse que ainda não está claro se isso foi o que provocou a tragédia. “As enchentes repentinas foram causadas por uma avalanche de gelo e rochas no lado nepalês”, disse Pokharel, que analisou as imagens da Planet Labs. Inundações, deslizamentos de terra, avalanches e secas estão aumentando em frequência e intensidade em todo o Hindu Kush-Himalaia, e as mudanças aceleradas na água, no solo e no ar em toda a região representam uma grande ameaça para as pessoas, afirma o Centro Internacional para o Desenvolvimento Integrado das Montanhas. O grupo informou nesta quarta-feira que a enchente repentina provocou uma forte onda de água, sedimentos e pedras pelos sistemas fluviais dos rios Bhote Koshi e Trishuli, acrescentando que os níveis de água no rio na área de Galchhi, a jusante, teriam subido até nove metros em 30 minutos.

item.title: Dolly Parton deja un legado de alfabetización, defensa de causas sociales y donaciones benéficas
item.description: Dolly Parton, el icono pionero de la música country, compositora y actriz que falleció el martes a los 80 años, significaba mucho más para millones de personas de todo el mundo.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: Dolly Parton, el icono pionero de la música country, compositora y actriz que falleció el martes a los 80 años, significaba mucho más para millones de personas de todo el mundo. Era un símbolo de generosidad, cuya labor filantrópica abarcaba la alfabetización, la ayuda en casos de catástrofes, la investigación médica y el apoyo a las comunidades marginadas y a la justicia racial, trascendiendo las divisiones políticas y culturales que transformaron el mundo que la rodeaba. Sus iniciativas benéficas se inspiraban en una infancia marcada por la profunda pobreza en la zona rural de Tennessee, lo que más tarde se convirtió en un elemento tan fundamental de su legado público como las canciones que la hicieron famosa. DEFENSORA DE LA ALFABETIZACIÓN La labor filantrópica de Parton incluyó la Fundación Dollywood, creada en 1988 para conceder becas a estudiantes de su ciudad natal, Sevierville (Tennessee). En 1995, puso en marcha la "Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library", un programa de alfabetización que pasó de ser una iniciativa local en el este de Tennessee a convertirse en una iniciativa internacional que proporciona libros gratuitos a niños desde su nacimiento hasta los cinco años. "Cuando crecía en las colinas del este de Tennessee, sabía que mis sueños se harían realidad. Sé que hay niños en sus comunidades con sus propios sueños", escribió Parton en la página web del programa. Esta iniciativa de alfabetización se convirtió en una de las expresiones más visibles del legado benéfico de Parton. El programa ha regalado más de 304 millones de libros a niños de Estados Unidos, Canadá, el Reino Unido, Irlanda y Australia, según la página web del programa. Su labor filantrópica también incluyó donaciones a la investigación sobre COVID-19, a la Cruz Roja Americana, a las campañas de ayuda tras incendios forestales y huracanes, a hospitales y a causas relacionadas con el bienestar animal. DERECHOS Más allá de su música, Parton fue una figura cultural aclamada por generaciones de fans y comunidades LGBTQ+, gracias a su reputación de inclusividad y aceptación. Apoyó el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo, criticó las restricciones a los derechos de las personas transgénero e incorporó esos temas a su obra. A lo largo de su carrera, Parton rara vez se adentró públicamente en la política o en cuestiones sociales. Sin embargo, en 2018, Parton eliminó "Dixie" del nombre de su espectáculo con cena ambientado en la Guerra Civil de Estados Unidos, rebautizándolo como "Dolly Parton’s Stampede", tras recibir críticas por su asociación con la Confederación. "En cuanto te das cuenta de que algo es un problema, debes solucionarlo", declaró Parton a Billboard en 2020. Durante las protestas mundiales de 2020 por los asesinatos a manos de la policía de George Floyd, Breonna Taylor y otros afroamericanos, Parton expresó su apoyo al movimiento Black Lives Matter, sumándose a las filas de figuras destacadas de la música dispuestas a pronunciarse públicamente sobre el asunto. "Por supuesto que las vidas negras importan", declaró a Billboard. "¿Acaso creemos que nuestros culitos blancos son los únicos que importan? ¡No!". Parton contó en el programa "Watch What Happens Live" de Andy Cohen en 2021 que destinó parte de los derechos de autor de la grabación de Whitney Houston de "I will always love you" a la compra de un centro comercial en un barrio de Nashville con mayoría de población negra, describiéndolo como un homenaje al legado de Houston. Entre sus últimas colaboraciones importantes, Parton trabajó con Beyoncé en el álbum "Cowboy Carter" (2024), ganador de un Grammy, que destacaba el rico legado de los músicos negros en la música country y abordaba temas como la raza y la identidad en Estados Unidos. La reinterpretación que hizo Beyoncé del éxito de Parton "Jolene" suscitó tanto elogios como críticas. Parton respaldó la versión afirmando que Beyoncé "le estaba dando un poco de guerra a esa chica (Jolene) ¡y se lo merece!".

item.title: Estados governados por democratas voltam a contestar planos de Trump de restringir voto pelo correio
item.description: Uma coalizão de Estados liderados pelos democratas renovou, nesta quarta-feira, seus esforços para impedir que o Serviço Postal dos EUA (USPS) implemente o decreto do presidente Donald Trump que restringe o voto por correspondência, buscando evitar que novas exigências sejam impostas antes do envio das cédulas para as eleições legislativas de novembro.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: Uma coalizão de Estados liderados pelos democratas renovou, nesta quarta-feira, seus esforços para impedir que o Serviço Postal dos EUA (USPS) implemente o decreto do presidente Donald Trump que restringe o voto por correspondência, buscando evitar que novas exigências sejam impostas antes do envio das cédulas para as eleições legislativas de novembro. Procuradores-gerais democratas de 23 Estados e do Distrito de Columbia, juntamente com o governador da Pensilvânia, entraram com a ação no tribunal federal de Boston dois dias depois que a Suprema Corte dos EUA revogou uma liminar anterior que eles haviam obtido, bloqueando o decreto de Trump com o argumento de que a ação havia sido movida prematuramente. Eles haviam entrado com aquela ação anterior antes que o USPS finalizasse a norma que implementaria o decreto assinado pelo presidente republicano em março, voltado para os votos por correspondência. O USPS divulgou a norma definitiva na sexta-feira, apesar de uma liminar que ainda estava em vigor, destinada a impedir que o serviço postal cumprisse o plano de Trump. Até esta quarta-feira, o USPS estava impedido de implementar essa nova regra devido a outra liminar emitida pela juíza federal Indira Talwani, de Boston, em um processo relacionado movido por grupos de defesa do direito ao voto. Mas, a pedido do governo Trump, Talwani revogou sua liminar logo após os Estados entrarem com a ação, alegando que ela não poderia ser mantida após a decisão da Suprema Corte, apesar de “qualquer caos que possa ser desencadeado enquanto o litígio estiver pendente”. Os Estados, em sua nova ação, solicitaram agora a Talwani — nomeada pelo presidente democrata Barack Obama — que volte a impedir a implementação da nova regra do USPS, que exige que os Estados forneçam à agência listas de eleitores que pretendem votar pelo correio e impõe novos requisitos federais para os envelopes de cédulas, que agora devem conter códigos de barras exclusivos. A nova regra exige que o USPS verifique as cédulas enviadas pelo correio e permite que a agência se recuse a entregá-las caso não estejam em conformidade com seus padrões ou se os eleitores não constarem nas listas dos Estados. Os Estados liderados pelos democratas afirmam que os novos requisitos, se entrarem em vigor, poderão sobrecarregá-los significativamente nas semanas que antecedem a eleição, forçando-os a comprar novos envelopes e equipamentos, estabelecer novos sistemas e treinar funcionários. “Essa nova política só vai gerar confusão, custos desnecessários e riscos inaceitáveis para os eleitores na véspera do dia da eleição, e meu gabinete vai recorrer à Justiça para bloqueá-la”, afirmou a procuradora-geral de Nova York, Letitia James, em comunicado. Ela e outros procuradores-gerais estaduais argumentam que o USPS não tem autoridade para estabelecer requisitos federais de elegibilidade para o voto por correspondência e que sua regra entra em conflito com as leis federais que protegem os direitos dos eleitores e a autoridade dos Estados, prevista na Constituição dos EUA, para administrar eleições. Os Estados, que também incluem a Califórnia e Massachusetts, argumentam que a regra corre o risco de privar eleitores do direito de voto. Durante a eleição de 2024, o USPS processou quase 100 milhões de cédulas eleitorais. Cerca de 30% dos eleitores em todo o país votaram pelo correio, afirmam os Estados. O USPS não respondeu aos pedidos de comentário. Grupos de defesa do direito ao voto e alas do Partido Democrata, em documentos apresentados na terça-feira em ações judiciais separadas, afirmaram que estavam tomando medidas semelhantes para bloquear a regra do USPS, que, segundo eles, já está pronta para julgamento.

item.title: Ivory Coast's delayed cocoa crop could mean congested ports ahead of EU rules, sources say
item.description: Ivory Coast's Coffee and Cocoa Council is concerned a delayed start to the 2026/27 main cocoa crop could lead to port congestion as exporters rush to ship before stricter European Union deforestation rules take effect at the year-end, industry sources said.
item.dc:creator: Ange Aboa
item.content:encoded: Ivory Coast's Coffee and Cocoa Council is concerned a delayed start to the 2026/27 main cocoa crop could lead to port congestion as exporters rush to ship before stricter [USN:L8N44G0G0 TEXT:"European Union deforestation rules"] take effect at the year-end, industry sources said. The council, which is the industry regulator in the world's biggest cocoa-producing country, said last week the country was ready for [USN:L8N44G0G0 TEXT:"the new rules."] Two sources from the council and five exporters, however, said this week they expected congestion at the ports of Abidjan and San Pedro in November and December, adding storage capacity could be strained. They said the main cocoa crop had been delayed by a combination of difficult weather conditions, insufficient farm maintenance and the strength of the mid-crop, which delayed development of the main crop. One source said the main crop would be delayed by eight to 10 weeks. The sources spoke on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the issue. "With this looming delay, we will find ourselves having to export enormous quantities in a short period in December," an executive at a European export company in Abidjan said. One of the two cocoa council officials said the body would do everything possible to minimise the impact. Even though the main season will begin on September 1, the sources said weekly arrivals were expected to stay below 15,000 metric tons in September and 25,000 tons in October. Main-crop volumes should begin arriving in late October or early November and increase through December, they said. The cocoa council expects total arrivals from the main crop, beginning from September and ending on February 28, 2027, to be no more than 1.4 million tons. Exporters forecast 1.4 million to 1.45 million metric tons. About 900,000 tons of cocoa are expected to reach Ivorian ports between October and December 2026, compared with an updated 1.1 million tons in the same period in 2025. Typically, ports receive 800,000 to 1 million tons over those three months.

item.title: FIA autoriza mejoras en los motores de Mercedes, líder de la F1, pero no para Red Bull
item.description: Mercedes podrá realizar mejoras en el motor, a pesar de liderar ambos campeonatos de Fórmula Uno por un margen considerable, después de que la FIA, organismo rector, concluyera que Red Bull -cuarto en la clasificación general y sin ninguna victoria en 2026- tiene la unidad de potencia más fuerte.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Mercedes podrá realizar mejoras en el motor, a pesar de liderar ambos campeonatos de Fórmula Uno por un margen considerable, después de que la FIA, organismo rector, concluyera que Red Bull -cuarto en la clasificación general y sin ninguna victoria en 2026- tiene la unidad de potencia más fuerte. La FIA publicó el miércoles las conclusiones de su mecanismo de Oportunidades Adicionales de Desarrollo y Mejora (ADUO) y afirmó que Mercedes podría realizar una homologación adicional del motor en 2026 y otra en 2027, con los correspondientes aumentos del límite de costos y de las pruebas en banco de potencia. El ADUO concede a los fabricantes de unidades de potencia de la F1 mejoras adicionales si el rendimiento de su motor de combustión interna (ICE) se sitúa al menos un 2% por debajo del que tenga mejor rendimiento en la disciplina deportiva durante los periodos de revisión definidos. El primer periodo de revisión finalizó tras el Gran Premio de Canadá en mayo y el segundo, tras el de Hungría a fines de julio. Esta temporada comenzó una nueva era de motores y el ADUO está diseñado para evitar que un fabricante consiga una ventaja significativa sin que sus rivales puedan responder. Se constató que Mercedes estaba en el margen del 2-4% en el primer periodo, mientras que Audi, Ferrari y Honda superaban el 4%, por lo que se les concedieron dos homologaciones adicionales en 2026 y otras dos el año que viene. Mercedes suministra motores a cuatro escuderías, Ferrari a tres y Audi y Honda a una cada una. No se mencionó a Red Bull, lo que confirma que su motor -utilizado también por su equipo hermano, Racing Bulls- se considera el punto de referencia, a pesar de que esta temporada es la primera en la que cuentan con su propia unidad de potencia, desarrollada en colaboración con Ford. Tras 12 pruebas, Mercedes aventaja a Ferrari en 87 puntos, mientras que Red Bull se encuentra a 239 puntos del líder. El equipo campeón, McLaren -tercero en la clasificación general y ganador de las dos últimas carreras-, también utiliza motores Mercedes. Las puntuaciones de la ADUO ya se habían filtrado tras el primer periodo, lo que provocó polémica dado el dominio de Mercedes al ganar las seis primeras carreras de la temporada, incluidas cinco consecutivas del líder del campeonato, Kimi Antonelli. Red Bull solicitó una aclaración en junio, preocupado por que se estuviera concediendo una ventaja en materia de desarrollo a rivales más competitivos. "A todos nos sorprendió un poco esa noticia", declaró en su momento el cuatro veces campeón del mundo de Red Bull, Max Verstappen. No se concedieron homologaciones adicionales para el segundo periodo. Nikolas Tombazis, director de monoplazas de la FIA, afirmó que el análisis fue "minucioso y exhaustivo" y que el organismo rector confía en los resultados.

item.title: Fever-Sky most-watched regular-season game since 1997
item.description: The Indiana Fever's clash with the host Chicago Sky on Sunday averaged 3.31 million viewers on NBC and Peacock, making it the WNBA's most-watched regular-season game since the league's inaugural season in 1997.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indiana Fever's clash with the host Chicago Sky on Sunday averaged 3.31 million viewers on NBC and Peacock, making it the WNBA's most-watched regular-season game since the league's inaugural season in 1997. It was also the third most-watched regular-season game in league history. The New York Liberty-Los Angeles Sparks season-opening game on June 21, 1997, averaged 5.04 million viewers. The Charlotte Sting and Phoenix Mercury tipped off the following day, with 3.59 million viewers tuning in. Those games were also broadcast on NBC. Caitlin Clark sank a career-best eight 3-pointers to highlight a 37-point performance in the Fever's 113-90 victory. The teams were meeting for the first time since Indiana's Sophie Cunningham was fouled on a breakaway by Chicago's DiJonai Carrington during a game on Aug. 8. Carrington was ejected for a Flagrant 2 foul in the Fever's 90-86 win. --Field Level Media

item.title: SNB's Martin says "robust" level of capital not a disadvantage for banks
item.description: Banks holding a "robust" amount of capital are not necessarily at a commercial disadvantage to rivals, Swiss National Bank Vice Chairman Antoine Martin said on Wednesday, as Swiss lawmakers prepare to discuss tougher capital requirements for UBS .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Banks holding a "robust" amount of capital are not necessarily at a commercial disadvantage to rivals, Swiss National Bank Vice Chairman Antoine Martin said on Wednesday, as Swiss [USN:S8N3Z10F1 TEXT:"lawmakers"] prepare to discuss tougher capital requirements for UBS (UBSG.S) . Banks with higher levels of capital did well after the global financial crisis because they were able to buy rivals that ran into difficulties, Martin told an event in Basel. "And so in Switzerland, if we think that we're living in an unstable environment, I would prefer our banks to have robust capital buffers and take market share from foreign banks who are going to be in trouble next time there's a downturn," he said, without naming any lenders.

item.title: Lawmakers seek probe into US failure to enforce airline passenger privacy rules
item.description: Two Democratic U.S. lawmakers on Wednesday asked a congressional watchdog agency to investigate the Transportation Department's failure to ensure privacy of airline passengers.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: Two Democratic U.S. lawmakers on Wednesday asked a congressional watchdog agency to investigate the Transportation Department's failure to ensure privacy of airline passengers. Senator Ron Wyden and Representative Shontel Brown asked the Government Accountability Office to investigate USDOT, saying it has never brought any enforcement cases tied to passenger data for over 40 years "despite numerous widely-publicized privacy disasters impacting hundreds of millions of travelers." A GAO spokesperson confirmed it has received the request and would determine how to respond. "USDOT'S abdication of its role as a privacy regulator has left the sensitive personal information of hundreds of millions of Americans exposed to corporate exploitation, warrantless government surveillance, and warrantless seizure of money and other property," the letter said, adding "Travel data held by airlines and travel agencies may be of interest to foreign adversaries." A spokesperson for U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy did not immediately comment. Then-Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg in March 2024 under President Joe Biden opened a review of how the 10 largest U.S. airlines collect and use passenger information. The letter said two years later "it remains entirely unclear whether a meaningful review ever took place." USDOT did not make airlines' response letters public and did not announce public findings or pursue any subsequent enforcement actions. Airlines for America, an industry group, declined to comment. The letter noted that for years the Airline Reporting Corporation -- collectively owned by major U.S. airlines -- sold access to a massive database containing roughly 722 million passenger travel records to federal agencies, including the Homeland Security Department and Internal Revenue Service, without warrants or court oversight. The letter noted in November 2025 ARC ended the effort but this year DHS issued a public request to government contractors for a replacement airline passenger surveillance system. The letter also cited a 2016 Justice Department audit that the Drug Enforcement Administration had paid airline employees millions of dollars to obtain some Americans’ private passenger data. Mishandling consumers’ private information may be considered an unfair or deceptive practice by airlines and could result in civil penalties.
